acip: MA GRUB NA, RTAG PA DANG GCIG CHOS CAN, KHYOD YANG YIN, KVA BUM GNYIS DANG MI 'GAL BA YANG YIN PA'I GZHI MTHUN PA MED PAR THAL, RTAG PA DE YIN DGOS LA MIN, DE LAS GZHAN PA GCIG MED PA'I PHYIR,
wylie: ma grub na, rtag pa dang gcig chos can, khyod yang yin, kva bum gnyis dang mi 'gal ba yang yin pa'i gzhi mthun pa med par thal, rtag pa de yin dgos la min, de las gzhan pa gcig med pa'i phyir
english: I disagree there is no example of a thing which is both the same as unchanging things, and yet not contradictory to the pair of a coffee table and a coffee cup. Suppose you do disagree. In that case, let us consider that which is the same as unchanging things. It is so the case that there is no example of a thing which is both it, and yet not contradictory to the pair of a coffee table and a coffee cup; Because (1) that one thing would have to be an unchanging thing, and it is not such a thing; and (2) there is no example of something else which could be.
